name: University of Brighton
description:
Are you looking for a university along the south coast of England? A university famed for its atmosphere of creativity and cultural diversity?

Brighton University might be the university for you.

The university is in the top 30% of universities for graduate incomes within three years of graduation, meaning attending the university primes international students for financial success.

Brighton University has core values: inclusivity, sustainability, creativity, and partnership. This is reflected on their campus, with Engineering, Technology, Arts and Humanities courses making up a large majority of the degrees on offer from the university.

What do international students have to say?

The University of Brighton dates back to 1882 but gained its university status much more recently, in 1992. Originally based next to the Royal Pavilion it now has three campuses across the city and one in nearby Eastbourne.

More than 3,000 international students attend the University of Brighton each year and it is internationally renowned for its research facilities and output. Located in one of the UKâ€™s most popular seaside towns, Brighton offers a different kind of lifestyle, with easy access to the beach. Thereâ€™s also a lively and diverse cultural scene in the city, making it a great place for international students.

Why Brighton University?

  • Leading research opportunities that are geared towards making a difference
  • An inclusive campus atmosphere within a multicultural city that is accepting of all faiths
  • Achieved the Silver Award for Teaching Excellence (TEF 2023)

Picture yourself graduating from Brighton University with friends from different backgrounds and the knowledge you have set yourself up for a lucrative graduate job. Imagine walking to the beach everyday after a lecture and graduating in a vibrant city on the South Coast. Envision the bright future that awaits you.

Donâ€™t let your dreams stay dreams.

Join the thousands of students from across the world who have made a name for themselves at Brighton University.

Brighton University has an array of impressive stats! 

  • 81% of graduates are in highly skilled roles after graduation. (Graduate Outcomes 2023)
  • 91% of graduates are in work or further study. (all respondents, Graduate Outcomes 2023)
  • Brighton is in the top 50 universities in England for graduate prospects. (2024 Complete University Guide)

Perhaps you have previously been struggling to narrow down which universities are the most liberal in their attitudes? Are you worried about choosing a university without many vegetarian options? Maybe you want to study a mathematics-based degree in a creative environment?

Discover why Brighton University might just be the place for you!

View courses now

Brighton University provides many facilities for students, including:

  • Sallis Benney Theatre
  • Gallery exhibition programme
  • SouthCoast Conferences
  • Sports Centre
  • Large fitness suite
  • Seminar room
  • Five outdoor grass football pitches
  • One outdoor grass rugby pitch
  • Sports Pavilion Building

Student Life

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The University of Brighton is a public research institution with a history dating back to 1858. It is widely recognised for its focus on professional education and practical learning, with a strong emphasis on empowering you to make a positive impact on the world.

The university hosts a diverse community of over 17,000 students, including a significant international population from more than 140 countries. Academic strengths are spread across various fields such as Art and Design (ranked in the global top 100), Pharmacy, Engineering, Business, and Health Sciences.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: You'll be part of a coastal community in Brighton, a city frequently voted as one of the top student cities in the UK for quality of life. At the university, you can join numerous student societies and clubs that cater to a wide range of interests, helping you build a strong social network. Dedicated support services are available for international students, including wellbeing teams and career development advisers, ensuring you feel secure and supported throughout your studies.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The University of Brighton provides a variety of on-campus accommodation options, with a guarantee of a place for eligible students. You'll get options such as Halls of Residence, single rooms with shared bathrooms or ensuite facilities as well as self-contained studio flats. 

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
1. Library

The university provides specialised libraries across its campuses to support your independent study.

 

2. Sports

Sport Brighton provides high-quality facilities for fitness and competitive sports, including a floodlit 3G AstroTurf pitch, activity studios, and a sports hall with badminton courts, a 25-metre swimming pool, a dance studio, and an artificial outdoor pitch.

 

3. Laboratories

The university is equipped with university-standard research and teaching labs such as clinical skills labs, molecular biology labs, and specialist engineering labs for structural dynamics and hydraulics.

 

4. Cafeteria

Each campus features a variety of dining spaces. There are numerous on-campus restaurants and cafes that provide fresh food and social spaces for students.
